description: Ramkhamhaeng's Tai expansion southward, traditionally said to have stretched to Nakhon Si Thammarat.

name: Srivijaya–Java war (1016)
description: Wurawari rebellion or Srivijayan-backed attack destroyed King Dharmawangsa's Mataram court (Pralaya Medang).

name: Khmer–Srivijayan raids
description: Sailendra/Srivijaya naval raids on the Khmer coast described in late 8th-century Chinese sources.

name: Battle of Manila (1365)
description: Majapahit naval foray against Saludong (Luzon) mentioned in the Nagarakretagama.
